mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear over City Hall under a full moon with a moderate air quality reading of 56, an overnight low of 63, and no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is rolling out a rain barrel rebate program to help residents manage stormwater, offering up to 30 dollars per barrel for eligible installations. Additionally, the intersection at Nine Mound Road and Mark Drive will be closed from August 5 through August 7 for essential utility work.

We have plenty to enjoy with the downtown farmer's market happening today, plus trivia night at the Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can enjoy free live music tomorrow during the Concerts in the Park series at Century School Park.
In a report regarding service calls, officers responded on Thursday, July 23, to a residence on Lucerne Drive where a 23-year-old man was arrested for disorderly conduct and intimidation of a victim.
The flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Peanut Buttercup, and you can pick up a scoop before the doors close at 10 PM tonight.
